# Mac YOLO Safeguards

> A free menu bar app for Apple Silicon Macs (macOS 14 or later) that keeps AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex from freezing the machine during long sessions.

Site: https://macyolosafeguards.io/
Source (MIT): https://github.com/IgorGanapolsky/mac-yolo-safeguards
Latest release: https://github.com/IgorGanapolsky/mac-yolo-safeguards/releases/tag/v1.2.1
Author: Igor Ganapolsky

## What it does

- Shows CPU, memory, swap and disk in the menu bar, with the process behind each, read from the kernel's CPU counters.
- Stops MCP servers and helper processes whose agent session has ended. It only targets agent and MCP processes, so terminals, tmux and running apps are left alone.
- One click clears agent logs in /private/tmp, old simulator runtimes and stale developer caches.
- Includes an MCP server (bin/mac-yolo-mcp) so an agent can check the Mac's health before heavy work.

## Install

- DMG: https://macyolosafeguards.io/go/dmg (MacYoloSafeguards-1.2.1.dmg, SHA256 6810c1a6273716a96a20b485b1373de29fcfdb8fae2f2ba316dc86a0fa730818)
- PKG: https://macyolosafeguards.io/go/pkg
- Homebrew: `brew install --cask igorganapolsky/tap/mac-yolo-safeguards` (the fully qualified name trusts just this cask, so no separate `brew trust` step)

All downloads are signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarized.

## Pricing

The app is free and complete. Paid options:

- Mac YOLO Pro Guard, $19 a month (adds Auto-Guard, which stops leftover agent processes and cleans caches on its own when memory or disk runs low; bug reports get priority): https://macyolosafeguards.io/go/pro
- Agent Reliability Diagnostic, $499 once: https://macyolosafeguards.io/go/diagnostic
- AI Agent Hardening Sprint, $1,500 once: https://macyolosafeguards.io/go/sprint
- Partner Pilot, $3,000 once (30-day team deployment with custom PreToolUse guardrails and operator SLA; invoice/ACH available if corporate card 3D Secure blocks): https://macyolosafeguards.io/go/pilot
